newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Woodside says gas sales exceed contracts.
newsitem.headline: Woodside says gas sales exceed contracts.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Thursday sales of liquified natural gas to Japan exceeded contract obligations in calendar 1996.
Woodside, a partner in the North West Shelf gas producing field offshore of Western Australia, said in its annual report it also was seeking new customers in the U.S. Europe and Asia.
Scope to achieve further sales will be enhanced with the chartering of an additional LNG carrier this year, Woodside said. The bulk of its sales are to Japan.
Woodside said its share of LNG production in 1996 was 1.253 million tonnes, nearly 10,000 tonnes higher than 1995.

Woodside, operator of the North West Shelf, said it expected to sign a letter of intent with Japanese customers around the end of 1997 enabling it to double North West Shelf output to around 14.5 million tonnes a year.

The equal stakeholders in the North West Shelf gas project are Woodside, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, British Petroleum Plc, Chevron Corp Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Japan Australia LNG (MIMI) Pty Ltd. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
